author: nerfgun2002
body: So, its been a while now, and I regret using hacks on my alt. I use hacks on pretty much all my accounts, but I manage to appeal nerfgun2002 because it was my main. I managed to convince the sr mods that I was not hacking and it was just a misunderstanding. So after going back on for about a few months, I found a build server, and I accidentally log on with my alt. I was mad that night, and I decided to go grief some people, and the next moment, I got banned. Someone manage to find my ip and evidence to get me banned on Avicus. I am truly sorry for causing so much trouble and "drama" and causing so much players to be affected. I am just begging for one last chance for me to start afresh.
